import React from 'react'; import { Button, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native'; import * as Print from 'expo-print'; import * as Sharing from 'expo-sharing'; import Duty from '../duty/Duty'; import Trip from '../trip/Trip'; import { OverTimeCalculationResult } from '../allowancecalculation/overtimeAllowance'; interface PdfGeneratorMobileProps { duties: Duty[]; designation: string; payBand: string; level: string; rateOfPay: number; selectedMonth: string; totalKilometers: number; mileage: number; nightDutyAllowance: number; leaveMileageAllowance: number; dearnessAllowance: number; progressiveDutyHours: number; overtimeResult: OverTimeCalculationResult | null; } const PdfGeneratorMobile: React.FC = ({ duties, designation, payBand, level, rateOfPay, selectedMonth, totalKilometers, mileage, nightDutyAllowance, leaveMileageAllowance, dearnessAllowance, progressiveDutyHours, overtimeResult, }) => { const generatePDF = async () => { const html = ` Duty Report

Duty Report

Designation Pay Band Level Rate of Pay Selected Month
${designation} ${payBand} ${level} ${rateOfPay} ${selectedMonth}

${duties.map((duty, dutyIndex) => `

Duty ${dutyIndex + 1}

${duty.trips.map((trip) => ` `).join('')}
Date Type of Work Train No. Dep. Time Arr. Time Source Dest. Distance Duty Hours Allowance Remarks
${trip.date} ${trip.typeOfWork} ${trip.trainNumber} ${trip.departureTime} ${trip.arrivalTime} ${trip.sourceStation} ${trip.destinationStation} ${trip.distance} ${trip.dutyHours} ${trip.allowance} ${trip.remarks}
Duty Info
Sign In Sign Off Total Allowance Total Distance Duty Hours Night Duty Hours Progressive Duty Hours OSDA RRA
${duty.signIn ? duty.signIn.toLocaleString() : '-'} ${duty.signOff ? duty.signOff.toLocaleString() : '-'} ₹${duty.calculateTotalAllowance().toFixed(2)} ${duty.calculateTotalDistance().toFixed(2)} km ${duty.dutyHours.toFixed(2)} H ${duty.nightDutyHours.toFixed(2)} H ${duty.progressiveDutyHours.toFixed(2)} H ${duty.isOSDA ? 'Yes' : 'No'} ${duty.isRRA ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
`).join('')}

Summary Block

Total Kilometers Mileage Night Duty Allowance Leave Mileage Allowance Dearness Allowance Progressive Duty Hours
${totalKilometers.toFixed(2)} ₹${mileage.toFixed(2)} ₹${nightDutyAllowance.toFixed(2)} ₹${leaveMileageAllowance.toFixed(2)} ₹${dearnessAllowance.toFixed(2)} ${progressiveDutyHours.toFixed(2)} H
${overtimeResult ? `

Overtime Calculation Result

First Fortnight
Start Date End Date Overtime Hours Overtime Minutes Overtime Unit
${overtimeResult.firstFortnight ? overtimeResult.firstFortnight.startDate.toDateString() : '-'} ${overtimeResult.firstFortnight ? overtimeResult.firstFortnight.endDate.toDateString() : '-'} ${overtimeResult.firstFortnight ? overtimeResult.firstFortnight.overtimeHours : '-'} ${overtimeResult.firstFortnight ? overtimeResult.firstFortnight.overtimeMinutes : '-'} ${overtimeResult.firstFortnight ? overtimeResult.firstFortnight.overtimeUnit : '-'}
Second Fortnight
Start Date End Date Overtime Hours Overtime Minutes Overtime Unit
${overtimeResult.secondFortnight ? overtimeResult.secondFortnight.startDate.toDateString() : '-'} ${overtimeResult.secondFortnight ? overtimeResult.secondFortnight.endDate.toDateString() : '-'} ${overtimeResult.secondFortnight ? overtimeResult.secondFortnight.overtimeHours : '-'} ${overtimeResult.secondFortnight ? overtimeResult.secondFortnight.overtimeMinutes : '-'} ${overtimeResult.secondFortnight ? overtimeResult.secondFortnight.overtimeUnit : '-'}
` : ''} `; const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({ html, orientation: 'landscape' }); console.log('PDF generated:', uri); // Share the PDF file with the user await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, { mimeType: 'application/pdf', dialogTitle: 'Share PDF', UTI: 'com.adobe.pdf', }); }; return (
